text:
My appointment was scheduled for 3:00 PM, and I arrived early at 2:55. Despite that, I waited about 20 minutes before meeting with the advisor I was assigned to. There was no acknowledgment of the delay and no apology.

When I mentioned the wait, the response was simply that no one had informed him. The tone of the interaction felt dismissive rather than service-oriented.

Additionally, while I was carrying two child car seats, he walked ahead of me and made only a minimal effort to hold the door. It may seem like a small detail, but it reflects the overall lack of attentiveness during the visit.

For a dealership that promotes a premium customer experience, I expected significantly better communication, professionalism, and basic courtesy. Unfortunately, this visit did not meet that standard.

Davis Richards at Park Place BodyWerks is an honest, straightforward, and knowledgeable estimator. I worked with Davis this past month when my car was declared a total loss, and he went above and beyond to help me understand the process and …

Jeff White was outstanding from start to finish. His communication was quick, clear, and he made himself available whenever I needed anything. He went above and beyond working with my insurance company to get the repairs covered, and any …

In November 2024, I paid $1,100 for a Viper alarm and Kenwood stereo installation. Within a month, I returned for wiring shorts, and four months later, I returned again for alarm reprogramming and wire adjustments.

By January 2026, the alarm wiring shorted and drained the battery, leaving the truck undrivable. I spoke with Mazin, who insisted I bring the vehicle in despite it being dead. A technician called me back to suggest a mobile inspection but never followed up.

Due to this lack of communication and an incoming storm, I towed it to a local shop. Their inspection confirmed that inconsistent wiring from the original technicians caused long-term damage. This cost me $500 in repairs and the loss of the $600 alarm.

I provided the tech with images and receipts in hopes to get better direction, his response > "I'm just a technician".

This place is way overpriced, and you’ll likely walk out feeling like you made a bad decision. I was quoted around $600, but by the time everything was done, the total was over $800. What I actually received was a $100 amp, one 10" speaker, and one small box. Definitely not worth anywhere near what they charged.

Their tactic seems to be showing you a lower number up front, then hitting you with a much higher total “out the door.” Very misleading. If you value honesty, fair pricing, and transparency, I would avoid this place. Take your business somewhere else i promise u that u will get a way better deal. Oh and a side note u will spend at least 4 hours waiting on services.

Horrible service, purchased an item here and they do provide warranty but that’s where they get you. They sell you faulty items that will bring you back and make you pay for labor while the item purchased originally sucks to begin with. Don’t recommend you coming here do research and go elsewhere or buy from a trusted site.

Be careful when you bring your own equipment for them to install.
I went to this place to insall speakers I purchased on Amazon.
When the job was done the speakers worked perfectly but one head light was out. What are the chances that exactly in those 2 hours of them installing speakers that headlight would stop working? Such a "coincidence", isn't it?
So They also offer LED lights and installation and since I was already there, and it was late on Saturday I went ahead and told the owner (after lowering his overpriced offer) that he can go ahead and install new LED lights which i didn't really needed when i went there.
They make the money by selling you their own products (which obviously you can get cheaper elsewhere), so when you bring  equipment you purchased elsewhere, be ready for them to try and make some more profit another way.
I hope I am wrong, Inshallah.
But I am not.

Other then that good service.

They enjoy wasting customers time. I called to check if I can come in without waiting for a long time, I was told to come that I'll be in and out. I got there and met almost 10 customers waiting on their vehicle. I was their for 4 good hours. Pathetic

This place is an absolute joke. I came here to get “ceramic” window tint after reading the reviews, 1000% misleading. They didn’t honor the quote I was given on the phone after giving them the exact vehicle information. The quality of work was complete garbage. I could’ve done a better job myself. Every single window had groups of bubbles and streaks where they folded the film. The edges were completely uneven. They scratched the window glass trying to cut the film. The film is already peeling off on one window. This is after only 1 week. If you have a car they deem interesting, they will without a doubt take it on a wishful joyride. Completely unprofessional and incapable of quality service. They have “warranty” but why go back if they lack the skills to ever do the job like a pro. Going to gladly pay 3x what these morons charged to get it done right. Save yourselves the hassle and go to a real business run by men not little boys.

Did business with this back in the early 2000's and always had a great experience. Here recently I called,  to see if they had an item in stock before I made a 30 mile trip to location. Mason told me he would text me pictures of what he had in stock on 3 different occasions and did not return call or text me the pictures. Been in Business Management for 30 hrs plus, I understand getting overwhelmed with customers can happen, but never tell a customer your going to return your call or text them back 3 times and don't deliver...I would never return or recommend this place again!! No personality!!!

Update: BUBBLES in window 4 days later.
Going to be completely honest here, my issue is with the morals standard of this service. I noticed my bumper was damaged when I got my car back. I had this front lip install the night prior and literally drove straight here to get my windows tinted. I cannot understand how I could have damaged the top lip being it doesn’t even touch the road. I didn’t park anywhere but here after I got it install. I called and the guy said he would run the cameras back and told me he’s sure his techs didn’t damage anything. I didn’t get a call back so I’m guessing it is what it is. Next issue is there was mess they left after the install, this is a brand new scat pack with the cloth seats, there were a lot of dirt, run off substances and left over tint on both of my back door panels. Also I was not honored the Groupon deal I showed them. Instead of getting full car tint deal listed for $100, I got the lowest quality tint they had to offer on just the back windows for that price. I gave it two stars because the tint they had no bubbles. Will update on quality of tint over time.

I went for a radio/back up camera install. they installed a default radio that did not work, and the damaged the front driver and front passenger door since he installed speakers as well and i didn't even ask for speaker just screen radio. he had quote me a price so there for i agreed but when job was done i was charged 2 times the amount he had told me. reverse light was damaged with a collision, cigarette lighter port for charger was damaged and is not charging(not working),,Mind you it was working prior taking car there, they charged me for a new tire when i didn't need one  but had a nail on it. and they are not wanting to give money back or is even offering to replace or exchange items

I was shocked at their prices and turnaround time only to find out it wasn’t true.  Good prices but doing more research it’s not that cheap.  New guy working promised me a 1.5 hour turnaround time on radio install.  Instead took 4 hours one day and I had to come back next day for them to finish.  Owner and manager were great and understanding.  They pushed/rushed my install next day.  Problem was I was there for SIX HOURS total to get radio installed.  Definitely longer than normal. Was lied to and promise broken by new employee.  Probably won’t be back but I’m assuming from reviews I was one of the very few to have bad experience.

Every customer deserves the basic human decency and honestly at every firm. A little bit of honesty about the waiting time would have made such a difference. Having to wait 7 hours for a sedan vehicle to be tinted was beyond ridiculous. Being honest upfront should be the first thing they should stress the most. The service was good after all. Do not attempt buying from Groupon too. Those prices are lies, and y'all will end up paying double what y'all have already paid on Groupon.

Do not get tint done here! After multiple visits to fix poorly done tint, I finally visited a new place. The manager said I had scratched my window, but turns out they scratched my window! This shop is scummy and I would not recommend having any work done here. They just want your money and don't care about the finished product. I'm so disappointed that they would do a poor job and then talk their way out of not fixing it. Along with the poor work, the manager told me not to get mad - as if he expects women to be emotional basket cases even though I have every right to. He gaslighted me into thinking they had done nothing wrong and it wasn't worth the trouble of trying more than I already had to get it corrected. Be smart. Go somewhere else. The new business I found has also  seen previous customers from Bonnie & Clyde from shoddy work.

I spoke to manager prior to coming in. He said no appt needed and gave me a quote. I called back and advised I purchased a Groupon. He said come in. When I came in sales persons told me they had reached  Groupon quote so I couldn't use and proceeded to up-sale me. I ended up leaving and will never return or recommend.

For the amount of money I paid, I am not happy with the results. I clearly stated I wanted a certain tint  percentage around the whole car and instead of doing it they tried to tell me the sunlight affected the outcome. It isn’t true and I feel swindled because I am a woman and they took advantage of it. I have different colors on my windows and it is so ugly. I should've stuck with the cheap tint like everyone else. I regret doing business here. And the wait time was terrible. I was told 3-4 hours but didn’t get my car back til 7 hours. And dont even attempt to use a Groupon(I didn’t) because those prices are lies. Not even the cheapest tint will be 100- it starts at 150.

Prices and products are good. The downside is that they take advantage of your time. I dropped my car off as soon as they opened and told me it would be ready by a certain time and it wasn't. I know it doesn't take 10 and half hours to work on a single car. Ended up having to wait an extra hour and a half. To top it off I have to go back sometime so they can get some bubbles off one of my windows. Never leave your car make sure you wait so they can get you out soon.

Went to have two subwoofers installed as I had used them in the past (years ago). They asked I could leave the car with them instead of waIting (which I did). I came back two hours later which caught their installer off guard and he went to either start working in my car or finish the work he already started. When I spoke to the sales rep initially I advised him that it was important to have a custom box as I don’t have a lot of room in my trunk so I was surprised to see a huge box pretty much taking up the entire space. I believe it was a miscommunication as I believe he thought I meant a custom box for the subs and not for the trunk of my car. Had I known the custom I requested was not done I would of not agreed to pay the price I was quoted.  That being said it was a clean shop and everyone was friendly and their lounge area was relaxing. The work they did is also adequate with one exception, they did not secure the sub and it constantly slides in my trunk.

Took off a star for the high price without a custom sub and for not securing it in my trunk.

I bought Groupon but they did not honor it.  I ended up pay more than full price for car window tinting (just because I drove too far, I had to got it done).  The guys were not very helpful.  They told me to wait 1 and half hour (sounded like it is a complicated job).  But it took less than half an hour !!!  I can not trust these guys.

They have horrible customer service. I had to take my car back 3 day in one week, several weeks after that because nothing I paid for worked right. Run they don't honor appointment times. I wish I could give them a 0. I am headed back to this place again this due to my lights still not working. This will be the 6th time in the last 2mos. So we previously had the radio install which was a horrible experience. Why have we had to go back again this week after Mercedes Benz has advised the reason the new battery we have keeps dying is because Bonnie & Clyde hooked up the radio incorrectly which is draining the battery and due to it having no way to turn it on or off it runs constantly. It cost another $300 to have it checked with Mercedes, another $150 for a portable battery booster to keep in the car. Bonnie and Clyde kept the car 2-days and when I picked it up today nothing has been corrected. Find a better company to work with or it will cost you more in the long run. I'm now headed to yelp and Facebook. It cost us over $400 to correct the problem they created to our car! I am filing a complaint with the Better Business Bureau because this place needs to be closed down!!!

After being told my install would take 2 hours, it turned into 5. After not installing my part, they told me I still needed to pay them. The guy checking me out said one plug didn’t fit and that’s why it couldn’t be installed. It’s literally the first plug you pull out after removing the unit! That took 5 hours? They lied about time spent working on my vehicle and tried to tell me foreign cars take more time to take a part. The manager even came up to me in hour 4 and said “it’s almost done, they are making sure everything works”. How did it go from making sure it works to the plug doesn’t fit?? They don’t know what they are doing, even if they say they can do it. They wait until hours later to tell you it can’t be done. The install guy asked me how to install it! I had to send him a video I found on YouTube.

They are polite and they do care about their customers best car audio and accessory store I have been to in the DFW area. I have had issues getting my HIDS working and they ended up giving me a free upgrade after I brought my car back. The only complaint was they weren't accurate on how long it was going to take. Was told an hour took 3. Bad experience but they care and that matter's to me.

They scratched the f out of the window trims of my brand new car and left sticky residue everywhere. Also I paid for the for the highest quality ceramic lifetime bs tint, ended up with quite a few bubbles and uneven cuts. Get your car tinted here only if u drive a beater and need cheap tints to beat the heat. Everyone with a nice car STAY AWAY!

I've been here a couple of times and they do a great job, but a couple of months ago I took my own radio to get it swap into my car because it had navigation and I specifically told them they needed to swap the harness  even though the one I had in the car would fit.  After they charge $75 to do the swap I came to find out that the installer only swap the radio and not the harness as I told them because not all the features on the radio would work. When I called back they told me to come back another day and I was just a block away and told them I had just left and that I didn't pay $75 for something that I could've done myself if I didn't need to replace harness, I immediately went back and stand next to my car and made sure this time they did the work I paid for.

I took my Jeep to Bonnie & Clyde to get a security system put in. Customer service was pretty good. They paid for an Uber while my Jeep was getting worked on. Prices were fair. Had issues with them putting it in the first time. It was not done  correctly the first time..little of a hassle... but I will say they went over and beyond to resolve the issue.

I had an alarm installed in my Jeep and it did not go well, granted my Jeep is very customized, but they should have said they were not able to work on something that complex. 3 weeks later I still can't drive my car. When I noticed the problem I took it in and they said they had no room for me.

CROOKED DONT COME HERE. They miss connected a system I brought in myself and came back and told me it was my subwoofer and tried to sell me a new one. Went to a different audio place and told me they found a wire connected wrong. Charged me 480$ and tried to scam me further. Crooks. Name is fitting

Wait time was horrendous. Got ripped off when I brought speakers to install, was charged for "custom bracket" was never shown the brackets before install. Speakers still didn't sit right after paying $40 extra for $5 brackets.

Rip off, won't be back.

I spent $1400 on sound system, alram, back up camera alarm, was told over the phone what they would put but once I got there they changed the brand and price. Figured ok I am already here and that's how they get you! Long story short, one of my rear speakers busted and I took it in because it was less then 6 months and all they did was adjust the settings to were you could barely hear the rear speakers .  My rear speaks are still busted, be careful where you go these guys are rats!

This is the second car i take to this place and the customer service is poor, the staff have a very unfriendly attitude like they don't want to answer your questions. Prices are very high for the quality of the job. They wanted to charge me $150 per side to put a small sticker stripes on my camaro. I wouldn't recommend this place.

This place didn't install my factory properly.  Went back the next day the manager said all 3 technicians were fired, but didn't tell me to come back to get my radio installed properly on a future day? I won't be going back to the location for audio service.

This review has been at least a year in the making. I CANNOT recommend this business. I had them install the Pioneer AVH-4200NEX unit in my Dodge Dart and it hasn't worked properly since day 1! The unit continues to reboot randomly and 99% of phone calls don't work because the other person can't hear me. I took my car back to the shop 3 different times last year and each time these idiots simply did a factory reset on the unit and it still never fixed the issue. I spent way too much money here for such unprofessional results.

They also told me that there was no way to keep the factory USB and aux inputs that are in the console and end up drilling a hole through the back of the console to install a USB extension that runs to the back of the unit. Found out this was a total lie as there's a harness that can connect to the factory USB lead that is on the passenger side of the shifter.

Unprofessional and, apparently, lacking any ability to research! Find another business if you can because not only is the installation shotty, they will lie to you about installation time! It took them over 8 hours to install my unit along with the 2 front speakers. I'm not exaggerating here as I specifically remember having to call into work saying I'd be late and then having to call to tell them I couldn't make it at all.

I went on 5/19/18 and the son of the owner was wanting to sell me something that I wasn't interested in, just wanted to upgrade the rear speakers to get some bass on a 2018 Accord. I explained to him that my wife is disabled and from time to time I must put a wheelchair in the trunk, he started by saying that I would have to start with a processor ($500.00) and a amp ($300.00) then go from their on some rear speakers. My son and I have been repeat customers since 2006 multiple times. This one time was a horrible experience. I will be buying some speakers through Amazon and doing the job myself.

I constantly was going back to this place because something would stop working properly. Often I would have to wait all day for repairs to be made. Upon taking my car apart and looking at everything they installed I found that many items appeared to be purposely not tighted. This is something car stereo shops do to keep you coming back in. You can't buy more stuff if you don't go through there door. I won't be going back.
We were expecting Top Notch good quality tint and work to be done since all the good reviews. They did a really horrible  job on my truck had to take it back for them to fix a couple days later.

I came here to get a remote start i had recently purchased installed. When i first called they told me it would be $99 to install. I show up the following day and tell them the remote start is in the front seat, the guy i spoke to over the phone was there and verified i said remote start for $99. I go back to work and a few hours later they call me saying they have to add a bypass modular for my original security by gm. Now my total is $160. Okay. The next day i go to pick it up and they didnt install my remote start, they installed some random keyless entry! And argued with me that i only said keyless entry. I said remote start over and over and that it was sitting in the front seat. They had to move it to drive! So it stays one more day to get redone. Now my truck throws missfire codes left and right if i use the remote instead of they key. And i recently got "reduced engine power" i took the panel off to see if they left a loose wire and saw they didnt use any approved electrical splicing coupling. Not even a wire nut. Every spliced wire is just held together by electrical tape!!!! This is the worst overly priced job ive ever seen. Ill be redoing my own truck the proper way myself. Cant believe a business is still going sending people off with taped goods. Do yourself a favor, find someone, somewhere else that has more than just tape and understands, remote start its in the front seat

I had To go back twice because they messed up my window tint twice! It took forever both times it was redone. I say if one person messes it up the first time don’t let that same person work on the car again. May have saved me a third trip. I inspected it before I left the second time it was done and noticed it was cut/scratched up again but I didn’t have time to wait for it to be redone so I had to make an appt and drive back a third time. Had to get a second pair of eyes because the guy who did it couldn’t see the scratches.  Maybe he shouldn’t be doing body work if he can’t see?
Great place to get deals and great installation for your car needs but be careful because I found tracker onmy car that they might have installed be careful!!!!

I would never go there again, but they do have the right name, because they stuck me up, first of all when I called they told me one price after I got that price doubled saying I was getting a better tint, but three months later my tint is already peeling and chipping, not to mention he told I would have 3 men on my car, since he saw I was an out town visitor, but it was only 1 man and it took 4 an hours of my day to do and it peeling, but I was told it was the best well good luck everybody, I guess your safe if you live there, but I will not recommend anyone to that place, and never go then again expect to get my money back, but hey they are living up to their name Bonnie and Clyde professional stickup artists, and that's what they are doing sticking people up without a gun everyday lol.
